exclusions.title: Internal traffic
exclusions.caption: Stop counting your own team. An excluded address never loads an analytics tracker, and its events are dropped on arrival.
exclusions.unavailable: Could not read the exclusion list.
exclusions.detectedEmpty: No staff addresses seen in this window.
exclusions.sharedEgress_one: Seen with {{count}} staff account, shared egress. Verify with whois before excluding.
exclusions.sharedEgress_other: Seen with {{count}} different staff accounts, so this is a shared egress (office NAT or VPN exit), not one device. Excluding a VPN exit removes every other visitor behind it and will not exclude staff, because exit IPs rotate. Check whois first.
exclusions.forwardOnly: Exclusions apply from the moment you add them. Data already recorded stays exactly as it is.
exclusions.deviceHint: Stops tracking on this device only. Survives a changing IP and affects nobody else.

coverage.none: No internal traffic is excluded yet, so staff visits are still counted in these figures. Add this device under Internal traffic below. Exclusions apply from the moment they are added and cannot change data already recorded.
coverage.partial: Part of this window predates the first exclusion ({{date}}), so the earlier days still include staff visits. Later data is filtered.
coverage.covered: Internal traffic has been excluded since {{date}}. Data recorded before that date still includes staff visits.

rangeDrift.title: These figures cover a different window

audience.title: Audience — our own data
audience.source: First-party events · every session, with the role attached
audience.chartTitle: Daily sessions, by who was here
audience.chartSub: Staff are shown rather than filtered out: on a pre-launch product they are most of the volume, and hiding them would flatter the chart instead of explaining it.
audience.emptyWindow: No sessions recorded in this window. This is a measured zero, not a failed read.
audience.showTable: Show the numbers as a table
audience.integrityTitle: How far the signup funnel can be trusted
audience.integrityGap: Accounts exist that the client-side funnel never recorded. The funnel only fires for visitors who accepted optional cookies and kept the tab open, so treat it as a floor — the server-side count on the left is the truth.
audience.integrityClean: The client funnel accounted for every registration in this window.
audience.acquisitionTitle: Anonymous visitors, and whether they came back
audience.acquisitionSub: One row per visitor who arrived without an account, with where they landed and whether they ever created one.
audience.noCampaigns: No visitor in this window arrived with a campaign tag. That is a marketing gap, not a data gap — no link we have shared carries UTM parameters yet.
audience.staffHidden: Staff sessions are hidden. This is not the whole picture — they were most of the volume.

usage.depthSub: Non-staff sessions only. A distribution, not a mean — one long session moves an average and tells you nothing.
usage.noDepth: No non-staff sessions in this window.
usage.healthSub: Every event in the closed vocabulary, and which have never fired. A metric that is silently absent looks exactly like a metric that is zero.
usage.allFiring: Every instrumented event has fired at least once.
usage.healthNote: An event here that should be firing is an instrumentation defect, not a quiet week. Check the emitter before reading its number as zero anywhere else on this page.
usage.adoptionSub: Roles against surfaces, all time — the "is anyone using this thing we built" table.
